title: Build a cushion path across the floor
description: The floor is the sea and the cushions are stepping stones! Build a path of cushions and pillows across the room and cross it from one side to the other without touching the floor.
author: SparkKindly · AI-assisted

body.heading: Lay the stepping stones
paragraphs: With a grown-up, lay cushions and pillows in a wiggly line across a clear floor. Put them close together at first — near enough to step from one to the next without a big jump.
Stand on the first cushion. Wobble is allowed! Arms out like a bird helps you balance. Step slowly, one stone at a time.

body.heading: Cross the sea
paragraphs: When you reach the other side, you crossed the sea! Now make it a little trickier: move one cushion a bit further away, or add a turn in the path.
Take turns with everyone in the family. Who can cross the slowest, like a careful heron? Slow and steady wins this game.

takeaway: Cushions are stepping stones across a pretend sea: lay them close, cross slowly with arms out, then make the path a little trickier.
ageGuidance: Ages 3-8: grown-up builds the path with the child and stays within arm's reach throughout.
supervision: A grown-up must lay out the path, clear the floor and stay beside the child for every crossing.
safetyNotes: Clear away furniture corners, toys and anything hard before starting.
Cross in bare feet or socks with grip — never run or jump between cushions.
Stop straight away if anyone feels dizzy or the cushions slide.
screenFreeExtension: Take the game outside: draw a chalk stepping-stone path on a patio and cross it together.
